scope: Deferred Manager application candidate; reference only, not the current chapter 9 fundamental learning target

source_study.population: Participants in the source smartphone intervention study, not a representative general population
source_study.unit: one participant at one observed EMA time

prediction_time: After the current EMA is observed and before the current intervention response is observed

available_inputs.rule: Only information observed by prediction_time; histories must end at that time
excluded: current intervention response not yet observed
available_inputs.study_constraints: Timestamp meaning, observation timing, missingness and all label semantics need audit before fitting

targets.name: recorded_intervention_response
targets.opportunity: intervention_computation == 1, with cohort and timing reproduced before training
targets.interpretation: Recorded yes/no response only; exact event meaning is unresolved
targets.missing_rule: Unknown remains unknown; do not silently convert missing to no

targets.name: next_same_day_reported_stress
targets.candidate_source: Stress at the next valid same-day EMA observation
targets.horizon: next observed same-day EMA; elapsed time must be checked; not next-day prediction
targets.missing_rule: No subsequent observation is missing, not zero stress

state_metrics: MAE appropriate to the verified scale
evaluation_design.uncertainty: Participant-level uncertainty; no deployment score threshold selected from the final test set

population_connection: No automatic linkage or extrapolation to Rhode Island synthetic residents
execution: No participant records or predictions are included in this definition
